title.narrative: NFiT projects for World Heritage 2024 Budget

description.narrative: The NFiT aims to contribution to the “Implementation of the World Heritage Convention”. • support World Heritage Convention broadly including cultural, natural, and mixed heritage and also including all regions. • provide smaller ‘seed funding’ for projects: the NFiT provides a useful means to support projects and reaches out to beneficiaries who otherwise would enable them to carry out the initial work necessary to attract further funding. • support specific projects (heritage site and/or theme) in relation to key challenges facing world heritage over the coming years (for example, climate change, biodiversity, SIDS and sustainable development). • support State Parties' efforts to respond to the Decisions adopted by the World Heritage Committee to improve the State of Conservation of World Heritage properties. • support actions/activities identified during the Periodic Reporting exercise and in the regional World Heritage Action Plans.
